submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.00075%) at Sb fraction 0.2275. EQE rises from 0.0645 (0.00041) to 0.1689 (0.00064), peaks at 0.2275, then falls at 0.2724 (0.00061) and 0.5105 (0.00023). XRD at 0.13 to 0.35 shows two phases: a Bi-rich phase (peaks near Q 1.99, 2.30, 3.26, 3.82) whose share drops as Sb rises, and an Sb-rich phase (Q 1.874, 2.372, 2.647, 3.551) whose share grows. The best EQE sits in the middle of this mixed-phase region.
